verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes found a live llms.txt at twilio.com, which hosts SendGrid's docs. The SendGrid docs landing page is also served as agent-friendly markdown at /docs/sendgrid.md. However, the llms.txt excerpt shown is Twilio-wide and does not show SendGrid-specific entries, and no first-party documentation describes these agent-oriented docs, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt indexes SendGrid docs specifically, first-party documentation of the agent-oriented docs offering (e.g. llms-full.txt or markdown for every page), independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
